useCases.title: Research event attendees and send outreach
useCases.message: Help me research attendees at an upcoming event and prepare outreach. Ask me which event I'm attending. You might want to figure out what my ideal contact looks like from what you know about my ICP. Find the best fits and draft personalised messages to get meetings booked before I arrive.
